title: Pentaryn Feature Riders
description: Does the riders dnd5e leaves to the player, from a small rules table keyed by feature identity and active only while the actor has the feature. Elemental Adept: 1s on the chosen type's damage dice of your spells count as 2 (core min2), and the damage tray starts with the target's resistance to that type ignored (the GM can switch it back; Apply keeps the choice). The card names what was applied under its dice row. Elemental Affinity: +CHA once per casting to a spell of your type. Potent Spellcasting (druid or cleric): +WIS to that class's cantrip damage. Healer: 1s rerolled on spell healing dice, and one Battle Medic activity that spends the TARGET's Hit Die and rolls it (1s rerolled) + PB; the active GM writes a target the player doesn't own, through a v14 user query. Also a -/+ on the character sheet's Hit Dice bar outside edit mode. Exposes game.pentaryn.riders.
